answer: Honest agents post a refundable stake and emit a public liveness beacon every epoch. A verifier watches the delta between the work each identity claims and the work its peers actually attest; when an operator spins up a plume of cheap clones, each clones diverging delta forfeits its bond. Faking identities then costs more locked collateral than a single honest node ever earns, so the sybil swarm bleeds itself dry.
